title: Six-site actual-Q3 full-generator Kubo-Mori pairing and cutoff-family diagnostic
question: Does the full-generator Kubo-Mori D/delta-D pairing remain valid on the registered six-site 2x3 graph over an increasing bond-coordinate cutoff family, and what finite growth is visible against the committed square baseline?
method: Build the registered six-site 2x3 Q3 Hamiltonian with oscillator dimension three, seven bonds, and the observable supported on sites 0,1.
For beta=1, times 0.05 and 0.1, radii 0.5,1,2,4, and both cutoff orientations, generate the actual D_sigma(t) history from H and H+sigma W_L, then compute delta_H D and delta_H^2 D.

Evaluate the two-sided Kubo-Mori form in the H Gibbs eigenbasis using the logarithmic-mean diagonal limit, and check full-generator cancellation, positivity, source locality, finite values, and row coverage.

Rebuild the same rows independently in the H eigenbasis, compare all summary fields within the declared tolerance, compile Lean R311, and compare the six-site maximum delta-D Kubo-Mori norm with the EXP-001140 four-site baseline.
finding: Primary 59/59, independent 56/56, integrated 13/13, and Lean R311 PASS over 16 six-site history rows. The full-generator identity <delta_H^2 D,D>_KM + <delta_H D,delta_H D>_KM=0 holds in every row; the primary maximum cancellation error is 2.1684090494798863e-19 and the independent lane agrees within the 1e-8 tolerance. Across the cutoff family, the primary maximum delta-D Kubo-Mori norm is 0.03381877701977454 at radius 0.5 and falls to 1.7361322766689837e-14 by radius 2. The six-site value is 1.4193189535517179 times the committed four-site beta=1 baseline value 0.02382746805088884. This is a finite growth diagnostic, not an asymptotic lower bound.
decision_reason: The exact finite pairing cancellation extends from the edge and square to the registered six-site graph, and an independent spectral reconstruction plus Lean R311 supports the algebraic sign and rational fixture. The finite cutoff family shows larger state-weighted delta-D at the smallest radius, but only one beta and one volume are sampled and no monotone asymptotic obstruction is certified. The source/volume/beta-uniform direct estimate, modular domain, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, and Pre-A remain open.

adversarial_review.check: The fixture constructs the registered six-site 2x3 graph with seven bonds and keeps observable support exactly at sites 0,1.
Radii 0.5,1,2,4 use the same bond-coordinate cosine cutoff and both orientations; the radius trend is reported as finite data only.
The primary commutator implementation and independent eigenbasis implementation both use delta_H(X)=i[H,X]/hbar, while Lean R311 checks the exact scalar cancellation fixture.
All shared six-site summary fields agree within 1e-8, but this is a finite numerical tolerance and not an analytic error bound.
The six-site/four-site ratio is computed from committed artifacts but is not promoted to monotonicity, divergence, or a route-specific no-go.
Uniform direct Cauchy, modular domain, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, and Pre-A remain explicitly open.

qft_interface.closed: A finite six-site actual-Q3 two-orientation D/delta-D history audit over a structured cutoff family with full-generator Kubo-Mori cancellation and an independent Lean-backed cross-check.
qft_interface.open: A source/volume/beta-uniform direct-Cauchy theorem, modular domain transfer, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Six-site finite extension and square comparison only; no asymptotic no-go, common dynamics theorem, or QFT reconstruction is claimed.

next_action: Derive a volume- and beta-uniform analytic bound for the Kubo-Mori delta-D norm on the common core, or enlarge the registered volume/cutoff family until a certified lower-bound mechanism—not a numerical trend alone—can decide whether this route is obstructed.
boundary: This is a finite actual-Q3 six-site full-generator Kubo-Mori pairing audit over one beta, four cutoffs, two times, and both orientations. It is not a source/volume-uniform D/delta-D theorem, a common infinite-volume dynamics result, a full QFT reconstruction, a gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A result.
no_overclaim: The finite six-site full-generator cancellation identity is valid and reusable, and the square comparison is a diagnostic only. It neither proves a uniform bound nor closes any common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A gate.
